faqSection.title: Before we begin.
faqSection.description: A few things clients often want to know before their first consultation.

items.question: What happens during the first consultation?
items.answer: We review your goals, background, education, experience and travel history. You will leave with an honest view of suitable pathways, likely timelines and the documents needed for a fuller assessment.

items.question: Can you guarantee a visa or admission?
items.answer: No ethical adviser can guarantee a decision made by a government or university. We can provide a careful assessment, a strong application strategy and meticulous preparation, while being transparent about risks and alternatives.

items.question: Do you support both work and study applications?
items.answer: Yes. Our assessment has dedicated pathways for skilled job applicants and for Master's or PhD candidates. Your consultation and checklist are tailored to the route you select.

items.question: How long does the process take?
items.answer: Timing varies by destination, program and individual circumstances. After your assessment, we provide a route-specific timeline covering preparation, submission and typical third-party processing times.

footer.description: Clear, personal guidance for international careers, postgraduate study and life beyond borders.
footer.legalText: Redpath provides immigration advisory and application-support services. We are not a government agency and do not make visa or admission decisions. Outcomes depend on the relevant authorities and each applicant's circumstances.
footer.privacyText:
We collect the information you choose to provide in our assessment forms so we can review your enquiry, recommend suitable pathways and contact you about a consultation. This may include identity, contact, passport, education, employment, language, travel and disclosure information.

We use your information only for legitimate advisory, safeguarding and legal purposes. We do not sell applicant data. Access is limited to authorised personnel and service providers needed to operate our secure website and database. Information is retained only as long as necessary for these purposes or applicable legal obligations.

You may request access, correction or deletion of your information, or withdraw consent for future contact, by emailing our office. Some records may need to be retained where required by law. Our assessment forms use encrypted HTTPS transport in production; please do not send original identity documents or payment-card details through the website.

consultation.termsText:
By submitting this assessment, you confirm that the information supplied is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. You authorise Redpath Immigration Advisory to review your details and contact you about suitable immigration, employment or study pathways.

This assessment is an initial enquiry, not a guarantee of eligibility, employment, university admission, visa issuance or any decision by a third-party authority. Formal advisory services, fees and deliverables will be set out in a separate service agreement before paid work begins.

You consent to the secure processing of your personal, educational, employment and disclosure information for this assessment. Sensitive information is handled confidentially and retained only as long as necessary for advisory, legal and safeguarding purposes. You may request access, correction or deletion by contacting our office. Do not include original identity documents or payment-card information in this form.
